versions.changelog:
No visible changes in this version.  
- Version 1.0.1 contains no file or documentation updates compared to the previous release.

- Initial release of the "last-mover-advantage" skill, focused on diagnosing when being first to market matters versus building an enduring position.
- Designed to activate when users question the long-term value of first-mover status, discuss endgame industry winners, or weigh market entry timing vs. durable dominance.
- Clearly delineates when to use (endgame analysis needed) and when not to use (first-mover advantage or market outcome is unknowable).
- Provides stepwise coaching for novices, including an adaptive approach based on user familiarity.
- Outlines a structured "Endgame Test" process to evaluate durability, market terminal structure, and strategic sequencing for lasting advantage.
